Params: {1: 'Assets/Product/Ui/Prefab/UiEffect/UiMovie/FxUiMovieBgSnow.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory85.png'}
{1: '1', 3: "A fine, gentle snow drifts down and settles on Lucia's and Lee's shoulders."}
{1: '1', 2: 'ARU Member', 3: "Thanks for everything you've done, guys.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'ARU Member', 3: 'The northern node is back online. Military comms should be restored soon.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'ARU Member', 3: "It's been an honor fighting alongside you both. We'll handle the rest from here.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Without a word, Lucia and Lee reply with a clean, silent salute.'}
{3: 'A surge of emotion rises in the ARU Construct. Will they fight shoulder to shoulder again? Will they ever face another trial as steep as this one?'}
{3: 'Perhaps they will. But for now, the sea has stilled, and the sunlight pours warm and brilliant over every soul.'}
{3: 'Down at the shoreline, a new ship awaits them.'}
{3: 'The well-known member of Gray Raven opens his mouth and pauses before finally speaking.'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: "I heard there's a fish in these waters called Arctic cod...", 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'ARU Member', 3: "Arctic cod! Of course. Local specialty. Best thing you'll ever taste, and packed with nutrients—", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Catching on, the ARU member breaks into a cheerful laugh.'}
{2: 'ARU Member', 3: "You want to bring some back? Hard to ship out these days. Once you leave the pole, you won't find it anywhere else.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lucia', 3: 'Lee, is this for Commandant?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lucia', 3: "I don't think Commandant's ever had it... Let's grab a few big ones.", 4: '1'}
{3: "Suddenly, Lucia studies Lee's face with a faint, puzzled expression."}
{2: 'Lucia', 3: 'Lee? Are you alright?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: 'My cooling system must be overloading. Probably the polar temperature.', 4: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1607.jpg'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Ui/Prefab/UiEffect/UiMovie/FxUiMovieBgSnow.prefab'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Once all repeaters and the temporary protocol check out, Sava gives Sidkosanatrahk a nod.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory213.png'}
{3: "In the next heartbeat, the Atlantic cable network's primary nodes come online in perfect sync, and the data flood surges out like a tide too long suppressed."}
{3: 'Across the network, countless people pause for a single, stunned instant, checking and rechecking the messages on their comms, unsure if it is real.'}
{3: 'The comms have recovered faster than anyone expected.'}
{3: 'At last, the familiar "call" from Babylonia appears on your terminal.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunNew.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1607.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1597.jpg', 2: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '12'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Celica', 3: 'Good news first: the military comms network is steadily coming back online. Full restoration should be complete by tonight.', 4: '12'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: "We're still searching for Arius' coordinates. No new developments yet, but with communications restored, reinforcements are already en route.", 4: '12'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: 'Next, the Balder will continue to the Atlantic Eye as planned... This battle is far from over.', 4: '12'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: 'Commandant, the comm lines are finally clear.', 4: '12'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: "Keep in touch and stay safe. We'll be waiting for your updates.", 4: '12'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: 'Looking forward to your safe return. Until then.', 4: '12'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunNew.prefab'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '12'}
{2: 'Until then, Celica.', 3: '79', 4: 'Yes, sir.', 5: '79'}
{3: "The long, low call of the ship's horn rings out across the sunlit, placid sea."}
{3: "More reinforcements pour in, busy erecting containment barriers to seal off the Red Tide's reach."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1607.jpg'}
{3: 'The cable-laying crew ticks through their final equipment check.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sava', 3: 'Hey, alphabet. This one, this one, and that over there. Take them all—', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: "Why am I the only one lifting so much?! I have every reason to suspect there's something personal going on here!", 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The two semi-rookies are still bickering noisily as Larsen descends the gravel path from the cliff above.'}
{2: 'Larsen, have you seen Captain Karenina?', 3: '94'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: 'Up there, I think.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: 'Oh! Gray Raven Commandant! Are you going to find the captain? Can I come along?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sava', 3: 'You will not. You have work here.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: 'And I take orders from you because...?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sava', 3: "Because I've been promoted. Supervising probationary members is now my job. And you are still a PROBATIONARY member.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: "Why didn't I get a promotion?!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: "Probably because you still haven't figured out when to shut your mouth.", 4: '1'}
{3: "Larsen watches the Gray Raven Commandant's retreating figure and shakes his head with a quiet smile."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1016.jpg'}
{3: 'You find Karenina in that field of cornflowers, holding the mechanical potted plant that Rarana once lived in close to her chest.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "The cable system's mostly stable. Global comms and data transfer are back to normal. You're headed to the Atlantic Eye next, right, Commandant?", 4: '1'}
{2: "Yeah, we'll be leaving soon.", 3: '120'}
{2: 'What about you, Karenina?', 3: '121'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Still some cleanup on the cables. I'm not handing that off to those rookies.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "So I won't tag along this time. If something comes up you can't handle, you know where to find me.", 4: '1'}

{3: 'Karenina waves a casual goodbye, keeping her head low. The soft rustle of combat boots through the vegetation grows fainter and fainter. The Gray Raven Commandant is already heading toward the next battlefield.'}
{3: "She's alone now."}
{3: "The sea breeze passes through the field of flowers with a soft, rustling sigh. Her gaze drifts down to the mechanical potted plant's biosphere."}
{3: "It holds no plant projections anymore, just one tiny blue cornflower, Cordelia's gift for her friend Lybia."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Look at the flowers, Commandant.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'When Cordelia fled the island in haste, the seeds meant for Atlantis were forgotten on this remote shore. They have since spread into a vast, silent sea of blue.'}
{3: 'Every seed has bloomed. Dew clings to the petals, and they catch the sunlight in countless tiny sparks.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "It'd be nice... taking a nap in a place like this.", 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1157.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{3: 'Where the blue flowers end, the boundless sea and sky melt together at the horizon, carrying back the echo of the waves.'}
{3: 'That echo never changes, constant as the rising and setting of the sun and moon. It has watched over generation after generation of life upon the sea.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1607.jpg'}
{3: 'Once, many years ago, a little mermaid made her way across the vast waters to this very place.'}
{3: 'She had only just left her first "home" and had not yet grown accustomed to water so cold or nights so dark.'}
{3: 'This tiny island was the first stop on her journey into the wider world.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1016.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{3: 'Perhaps it was weariness, or perhaps something else, but the timid little mermaid decided to rest among the flowers for the night.'}
{2: 'Lamia', 3: 'The world... outside... the world...', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1016.jpg'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront115.png', 3: '0', 4: '0.4', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'She drifted into sleep.', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Soft petals rested against her tail and brushed her cheek, swaying faintly with each quiet breath.'}
{1: 'It was a long, deep dream. The flowers, a gift that was meant for her mother, offered her a single night of peace.'}
{1: "In one fleeting moment of that dream, she found herself in her mother's arms, a place she had never reached in life.", 6: '1', 7: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1118.jpg'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1576.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{3: "On the night Cordelia learned of Lybia's death, she also learned that Lybia had left a child behind.", 5: '1'}
{3: 'And so, Cordelia understood what she still had to offer this world. After time had scorched away every trace of despair and loneliness, only love and longing remained inside her.'}
{3: 'It was all she had left to give.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1576.jpg', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Little budding soul, filled with her love and her longing, go now and see the world she missed so much and loved so deeply.', 3: '45'}
{2: 'Little budding soul, filled with her love and her longing, go now and see the world she missed so much and loved so deeply.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory00.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'Me? I want to become a road...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Cordelia', 3: 'A long road... bathed in the light of stars and the moon. I want the people I love to find each other through me... And find their way back to each other through me.', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1016.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'I will keep walking until... we meet again at the edge of the universe.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'On the cornflower-covered cliffs, she stands before the endless sea and watches the Balder drift into the distance.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory783.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{3: 'Seabirds wheel through the sound of the departing horn. The sea wind strokes her cheek, and the clouds and sunlight paint soft shadows across her face.'}
{3: 'The breeze, the clouds, the glow of the sky, everyone who loves her and everyone she loves, all of them reach through this moment to hold her.'}
{3: "It's an embrace years overdue, tender as comfort and gentle as a nudge forward."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory783.jpg', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Karenina looks down at the sextant resting in her hand.', 5: '1'}
{1: "She crouches down and sets it beside the stone carved with Cordelia's name."}
{1: 'There, tucked among the cornflowers, a worn little parchment booklet already rests in silence.'}
{1: "Its cover is aged and patched, mended across the years. Karenina thinks she glimpsed it once, held close in Larsen's arms.", 5: '1'}
{1: "The sea breeze joins her and turns the pages. It's a collection of poetry."}
{1: "The pages are yellowed with age. It's a relic of another time, and the verses within tell stories of the past.", 7: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory968.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: '"I found something worth living for. I wrote it into a poem."', 2: '000000ff', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront48.png', 6: '1', 7: '-6', 8: '1', 10: '1'}

{1: '"It\'s still not that great, though. You can laugh at me one more time, Cordelia."', 2: '000000ff', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront48.png', 6: '1', 7: '-6', 9: '1', 10: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory968.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.5'}
{3: "A small, fond smile touches Karenina's lips. She strokes Cordelia's name tenderly, then returns the little volume to its resting place."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "You won't be lonely anymore, Cordelia.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'She rests her forehead against the stone and closes her eyes.', 5: '1'}
{3: "Fate names it tragedy: a mortal's failed struggle against the insurmountable. Humanity names it life."}
{3: 'And those who rage against fate always stand closer to ruin than most. Even if nothing is left but ashes beyond recognition, that, too, carries its own meaning.'}
{3: 'Her terminal chimes, sharp and impatient, calling her to the next mission.', 7: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Time to go.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Karenina opens her eyes, and her golden irises blaze like sunlight.'}
{3: 'A smile spreads across her face.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1281.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{3: 'Fate can never crush those who want to leave something behind.'}
{3: 'From the deepest ocean, to the deepest ocean.'}
{1: 'For all who have ever raged against this sea.', 3: '55', 6: '1'}
{2: 'For all who have ever raged against this sea.'}
